200.description: The user with `invited: true` and `invitation`: `{ sent, error?, error_i18n?, error_values? }`

400.description: `error.invite-not-offered` (invitations are not offered) or `error.invite-not-allowed` (the user has a password or an OIDC link, or is disabled)

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot manage users`.

description:
Sends a new invitation mail to a user who has not set a password and is not linked to OIDC. The new link replaces the old one: the old link stops working. The link lives 72 hours. A mail that did not go out still answers 200 with `invitation.sent` false.

Needs: a signed-in session of an administrator (API tokens are refused)
